mcp.registration: Register modules/jarvos-agent-context/scripts/jarvos-mcp.js with the workspace agent configuration.

hydration.command: Call the jarvos_hydrate MCP tool at session start.
hydration.reason: This public adapter does not activate a global OpenClaw session hook.

activation.reason: Configured managed roots activate the reversible launcher; all other repositories and administrative commands stay on the bound original binary.

bridge.contract: The managed launcher uses the private bridge environment for lifecycle calls and records only the staged bridge executable and context paths under a SHA-256 key derived from the explicit OpenClaw session key or ID. The separate gateway process uses its own session context to select that exact mapping and may inject only a bounded public-safe judgment receipt.
